title: Binary Star Resonance
description: A Newtonian two-body orbit in barycentric coordinates. Kepler's equation is solved each frame for an unequal-mass eccentric binary, while colour and halo size remain artistic audio responses.
equation: M = E - e sin(E); x = a(cos(E)-e); y = a√(1-e²)sin(E)
numerics: Eight Newton iterations per frame; G = 1, m₁ = 1.2, m₂ = 0.8, a = 1.45, e = 0.34

physics.model: Newtonian two-body Kepler orbit in barycentric coordinates
physics.method: Kepler equation solved by Newton iteration
physics.caveat: The orbit is an ideal isolated two-body model. Stellar structure, tides, mass transfer and relativistic effects are omitted; audio changes only halo scale and colour response.

mobileStrategy: particle count reduced from 48000 to 18000 on coarse-pointer devices

references.title: NASA GSFC: Kepler's Laws of Orbital Motion
